results.rationale: The bottom-left block now presents an X, completing three X symbols down the left column and correctly establishing the win. Its red color differs from the existing blue X pieces, a minor implementation mismatch. Other symbols and cells remain in place, but wood-grain patterns, board proportions and block outlines change noticeably. The edited wooden game is structurally coherent, naturally lit and free of noticeable artifacts.

The truncated near temple is extended into a complete long arm with a curved rounded earpiece, satisfying the repair. The beige surface, rimless design and illumination remain similar, but the lens/frame assembly shifts visibly downward. The completed glasses have plausible connected arms, coherent reflections and natural tabletop shading; softness does not obscure their structure.
